#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Kimi Allegretto Code 额度与扣费系数工具

示例：
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py status                     查看当前 5h / 7d 用量
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py budget                     各模型可用 Token 与订阅折算价
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py budget --mix 2.5,0.5,97    指定 Input,Output,CacheRead 占比
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py probe --dry-run            只看复测计划与预计消耗
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py probe                      复测 K3.1 Pro + K2.8 Preview
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py probe --models all --cache-hits 12
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py analyze                    分析最新一份日志
  python scripts/kimi_quota.py analyze data/2026-11-03    分析目录下全部日志

说明：
  系数 = 每 1M Token 消耗的 5h 窗口额度比例；7d 系数 = 5h 系数 / 5
  API Key 读取顺序：--api-key > 环境变量 KIMI_API_KEY > 项目根目录 .kimi_key
  依赖：requests、scipy（budget 不需要）
  系数有调整时，只需更新「配置」一节的 MODELS
"""

import argparse
import glob
import importlib
import io
import json
import os
import sys
import time
import unicodedata
from dataclasses import dataclass, field
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from pathlib import Path
from typing import NamedTuple

# ============================================================ 配置


class Triple(NamedTuple):
    """按计费项排列的三元组：未命中输入 / 读缓存 / 输出。系数、价格、Token 数都用它表示。"""

    inp: float
    cache: float
    out: float

    def __add__(self, other):
        return Triple(*(a + b for a, b in zip(self, other)))

    def scaled(self, k: float) -> "Triple":
        return Triple(*(x * k for x in self))

    def per_million(self) -> "Triple":
        return Triple(*(x / 1e6 for x in self))

    def dot(self, other) -> float:
        return sum(a * b for a, b in zip(self, other))

    def __str__(self) -> str:
        return " / ".join(f"{label} {x:.4g}" for label, x in zip(ITEMS, self))


ITEMS = ("输入", "读缓存", "输出")  # 与 Triple 字段顺序一致


@dataclass
class Model:
    name: str  # 显示名
    rates: Triple  # 原价 5h 系数，单位 M⁻¹
    source: str  # "实测"，或推算依据
    api_price: Triple  # 国内站按量价格，元/M
    prefix_overhead: int  # 复测前缀里模板等额外 Token 数，用来把缓存前缀凑成 256 的整数倍
    promo: float = 1.0  # 当前优惠倍率，1.0 = 无优惠
    double_output_above: int | None = None  # prompt + completion 超过此值时，整段输出按 2 倍计费
    known_states: dict = field(default_factory=dict)  # 已知的其他状态 {实测 / 当前系数: 结论}

    @property
    def current(self) -> Triple:
        """当前生效的系数（含优惠）。"""
        return self.rates.scaled(self.promo)


LAUNCH_ERROR = {1.54: "与 10-24 凌晨首发时的错误系数一致"}

MODELS = {
    "k3.1-pro": Model(
        name="K3.1 Pro",
        rates=Triple(0.2810, 0.001407, 2.247),
        source="实测",
        api_price=Triple(13.0, 1.30, 68.0),
        prefix_overhead=96,
        known_states=LAUNCH_ERROR,
    ),
    "kimi-for-coding": Model(
        name="K2.8 Preview",
        rates=Triple(0.200, 0.001, 2.000),
        source="实测",
        api_price=Triple(6.8, 1.36, 28.8),
        prefix_overhead=97,
        promo=0.5,  # 官方半价，11-03 实测吻合；优惠结束后改回 1.0
        known_states={2.0: "优惠可能已结束：与原价一致"},
    ),
    "k3.1-pro-highspeed": Model(
        name="K3.1 Pro Highspeed",
        rates=Triple(0.5620, 0.002814, 4.494),
        source="推算 K3.1 Pro×2",
        api_price=Triple(26.0, 1.30, 136.0),
        prefix_overhead=96,
        known_states=LAUNCH_ERROR,
    ),
    "k3": Model(
        name="K3",
        rates=Triple(0.3300, 0.001647, 2.651),
        source="推算 Allegro×3",
        api_price=Triple(20.0, 2.00, 100.0),
        prefix_overhead=97,
        double_output_above=256_000,
    ),
    "k3-256k": Model(
        name="K3-256k",
        rates=Triple(0.3300, 0.001647, 2.651),
        source="推算 Allegro×3",
        api_price=Triple(20.0, 2.00, 100.0),
        prefix_overhead=97,
        double_output_above=256_000,
    ),
    "kimi-for-coding-highspeed": Model(
        name="K2.7 Code Highspeed",
        rates=Triple(0.600, 0.003, 6.000),
        source="推算 K2.8 原价×3",
        api_price=Triple(13.7, 2.74, 57.6),
        prefix_overhead=11,
    ),
}

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
DATA_DIR = ROOT / "data"
KEY_FILE = ROOT / ".kimi_key"
BASE_URL = "https://api.kimi.com/coding/v1"

WINDOW_DIVISOR = {"5h": 1.0, "7d": 5.0}  # 7d 系数 = 5h 系数 / 5
WINDOWS_PER_MONTH = 25  # 月额度 = 5 × 7d = 25 × 5h
SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES = (200.0, 160.0)  # 元/月：按月 / 按年（199 / 159 取整）

# budget
DEFAULT_MIX = "2.5,0.5,97"  # Input, Output, CacheRead 占比（%）

# probe
DEFAULT_PROBE_MODELS = "k3.1-pro,kimi-for-coding"
CACHE_BLOCK = 256  # cached_tokens 恒为 256 的整数倍
FIRST_REPLY_TOKENS = 32  # 未缓存请求的 max_tokens
CACHED_REPLY_TOKENS = 16  # 缓存命中请求的 max_tokens
LONG_OUTPUT_TOKENS = 2048  # 长输出请求的 max_tokens
QUESTION_TOKENS = 16  # 短问题在缓存前缀之外的 Token 数（估算用）
LONG_PROMPT_TOKENS = 130  # 长输出请求的 prompt Token 数（估算用）
MAX_5H_AFTER_PROBE = 0.98  # 预计测完后 5h 用量超过此值时取消

# analyze
READING_ROUNDING = 0.5e-4  # used_ratio 保留 4 位小数，真实值与读数之差不超过 0.5e-4
STATE_TOLERANCE = 0.02  # 判断是否落在已知状态倍率上的容差
FIT_DIGITS = Triple(5, 6, 4)  # 拟合结果显示的小数位w


# ============================================================ 计费


def billed_tokens(record: dict) -> Triple:
    """一条日志记录按计费口径的 Token 数。"""
    out = record["completion_tokens"]
    model = MODELS.get(record["model"])
    limit = model and model.double_output_above
    if limit and record["prompt_tokens"] + out > limit:
        out *= 2
    return Triple(record["in_miss"], record["cached_tokens"], out)


def quota_cost(rates: Triple, tokens: Triple) -> float:
    """按系数计算 5h 额度消耗（比例）。"""
    return rates.dot(tokens) / 1e6


# ============================================================ 接口


class ApiError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, message: str, retryable: bool = False):
        super().__init__(message)
        self.retryable = retryable


class Usage(NamedTuple):
    """额度读数：已用比例（4 位小数）与重置时间（UTC ISO 字符串）。"""

    used_5h: float
    used_7d: float
    reset_5h: str | None
    reset_7d: str | None


class ChatResult(NamedTuple):
    usage: dict  # 接口返回的 usage
    ttft: float  # 首个 Token 延迟，秒
    tps: float | None  # 解码速度，Token/秒


def load_key(cli_key: str) -> str:
    key = cli_key or os.environ.get("KIMI_API_KEY", "")
    if not key and KEY_FILE.exists():
        key = KEY_FILE.read_text(encoding="utf-8-sig")
    if not key.strip():
        sys.exit(
            "错误：未找到 API Key。请用 --api-key 指定、设置环境变量 KIMI_API_KEY，"
            f"或写入 {KEY_FILE}"
        )
    return key.strip()


class KimiClient:
    def __init__(self, key: str):
        self._requests = require("requests")
        self._session = self._requests.Session()
        self._session.headers["Authorization"] = f"Bearer {key}"

    def _request(self, method: str, path: str, label: str, **kwargs):
        try:
            r = self._session.request(method, BASE_URL + path, **kwargs)
        except self._requests.RequestException as e:
            raise ApiError(f"{label}：网络错误 {e}", retryable=True) from e
        if r.status_code == 401:
            raise ApiError(f"{label}：API Key 无效或已过期（HTTP 401）")
        if r.status_code != 200:
            raise ApiError(
                f"{label}：HTTP {r.status_code} {r.text[:300]}",
                retryable=r.status_code == 429 or r.status_code >= 500,
            )
        return r

    def usage(self, attempts: int = 5) -> Usage:
        """查询当前额度；网络错误、服务端错误时间隔 1 秒重试，共尝试 attempts 次。"""
        for _ in range(attempts - 1):
            try:
                return self._fetch_usage()
            except ApiError as e:
                if not e.retryable:
                    raise
                time.sleep(1.0)
        return self._fetch_usage()  # 最后一次失败时直接抛出

    def _fetch_usage(self) -> Usage:
        r = self._request("GET", "/usages", "额度查询", timeout=10)
        try:
            u = r.json()["usages"]
            return Usage(
                used_5h=u["limit_5h"]["used_ratio"],
                used_7d=u["limit_7d"]["used_ratio"],
                reset_5h=u["limit_5h"].get("reset_time"),
                reset_7d=u["limit_7d"].get("reset_time"),
            )
        except (ValueError, KeyError, TypeError) as e:
            raise ApiError(f"额度查询：返回格式不符 {r.text[:300]}", retryable=True) from e

    def settled_usage(self, wait: float = 1.8, max_wait: float = 12.0) -> Usage:
        """等待读数稳定（相邻两次读取相同）后返回额度。"""
        time.sleep(wait)
        last, waited = self.usage(), wait
        while waited < max_wait:
            time.sleep(1.5)
            waited += 1.5
            cur = self.usage()
            if (cur.used_5h, cur.used_7d) == (last.used_5h, last.used_7d):
                return cur
            last = cur
        print("  [警告] 读数仍在变化，可能有其他会话在消耗额度", flush=True)
        return last

    def chat(self, model: str, messages: list, max_tokens: int) -> ChatResult:
        """发送一次流式对话请求，返回 usage 与速度。"""
        payload = {
            "model": model,
            "messages": messages,
            "max_tokens": max_tokens,
            "stream": True,
            "stream_options": {"include_usage": True},
        }
        label = f"{model} 对话"
        t0 = time.perf_counter()
        t_first = t_last = None
        usage = {}
        try:
            with self._request(
                "POST", "/chat/completions", label, json=payload, stream=True, timeout=300
            ) as r:
                for chunk in iter_sse(r):
                    usage = chunk.get("usage") or usage
                    delta = (chunk.get("choices") or [{}])[0].get("delta") or {}
                    if delta.get("reasoning_content") or delta.get("content"):
                        t_first = t_first or time.perf_counter()
                        t_last = time.perf_counter()
        except self._requests.RequestException as e:
            raise ApiError(f"{label}：读取响应时出错 {e}") from e

        t_end = time.perf_counter()
        gen_time = t_last - t_first if t_first and t_last and t_last > t_first else 0.0
        out = usage.get("completion_tokens", 0)
        return ChatResult(
            usage=usage,
            ttft=round((t_first or t_end) - t0, 3),
            tps=round(out / gen_time, 1) if gen_time > 0.05 and out else None,
        )


def iter_sse(response):
    """逐个产出 SSE 流里的 JSON 数据块，遇到 [DONE] 结束。"""
    for line in response.iter_lines():
        text = line.decode("utf-8", errors="replace") if line else ""
        if not text.startswith("data: "):
            continue
        data = text[6:].strip()
        if data == "[DONE]":
            return
        try:
            yield json.loads(data)
        except ValueError:
            continue


def window_reset(before: Usage, after: Usage) -> bool:
    """5h 窗口是否在两次读数之间重置：读数下降，或重置时间跳变超过 60 秒（reset_time 本身有 ±1 秒抖动）。"""
    if after.used_5h < before.used_5h:
        return True
    t0, t1 = parse_time(before.reset_5h), parse_time(after.reset_5h)
    return bool(t0 and t1 and abs((t1 - t0).total_seconds()) > 60)


# ============================================================ status：当前用量


def print_usage(u: Usage):
    rows = [
        ("5h", fmt_pct(u.used_5h), fmt_pct(1 - u.used_5h), fmt_reset(u.reset_5h)),
        ("7d", fmt_pct(u.used_7d), fmt_pct(1 - u.used_7d), fmt_reset(u.reset_7d)),
    ]
    print_table(("窗口", "已用", "剩余", "重置时间"), rows, align="<>><")


def cmd_status(args):
    print_usage(KimiClient(load_key(args.api_key)).usage())


# ============================================================ budget：可用量与折算价


def budget_rows():
    """产出 (显示名, 来源, 系数, API 价格)。

    系数与价格完全相同的模型合并为一行（如 K3 / K3-256k）；
    有优惠的分「优惠 / 原价」两行，有长上下文加价的分「≤ / > 阈值」两行。
    """
    groups = {}
    for m in MODELS.values():
        key = (m.rates, m.api_price, m.source, m.promo, m.double_output_above)
        groups.setdefault(key, []).append(m)

    for same in groups.values():
        m = same[0]
        name = " / ".join(x.name for x in same)
        if m.promo != 1.0:
            yield f"{name}（Promo ×{m.promo:g}）", m.source, m.current, m.api_price
            yield f"{name}（原价）", m.source, m.rates, m.api_price
        elif m.double_output_above:
            limit = f"{m.double_output_above // 1000}K"
            doubled = m.rates._replace(out=m.rates.out * 2)
            yield f"{name}（≤{limit}）", m.source, m.rates, m.api_price
            yield f"{name}（>{limit}）", m.source, doubled, m.api_price
        else:
            yield m.name, m.source, m.rates, m.api_price


def subscription_price(rate: float, api_price: float) -> str:
    """单个计费项的订阅折算价，格式「按月 / 按年 (API 价)」，单位元/M。"""
    share_of_month = rate / WINDOWS_PER_MONTH
    monthly, yearly = SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES
    return (
        f"{fmt_price(share_of_month * monthly)} / {fmt_price(share_of_month * yearly)}"
        f" ({api_price:g})"
    )


def cmd_budget(args):
    p_in, p_out, p_cache = (x / sum(args.mix) for x in args.mix)
    share = Triple(p_in, p_cache, p_out)
    rows = list(budget_rows())

    print(
        f"各模型可用 Token（用量占比 Input {p_in * 100:.3g}% / Output {p_out * 100:.3g}% / "
        f"CacheRead {p_cache * 100:.3g}%）\n"
    )
    table = []
    for name, source, rates, _ in rows:
        per_5h = 1.0 / rates.dot(share)  # 单位 M
        per_7d = per_5h * WINDOW_DIVISOR["7d"]
        table.append((name, source, f"{per_5h:.1f}M", f"{per_7d:.1f}M"))
    print_table(("模型", "来源", "5h 可用", "7d 可用"), table, align="<<>>")

    monthly, yearly = SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES
    print(
        f"\n订阅折算价（元/M）：每格为「按月 ¥{monthly:g} / 按年 ¥{yearly:g} (国内站 API 价)」\n"
    )
    table = [
        (name, *(subscription_price(r, p) for r, p in zip(rates, api)))
        for name, _, rates, api in rows
    ]
    print_table(("模型", *ITEMS), table)


# ============================================================ probe：调用接口复测


class ProbeStep(NamedTuple):
    tag: str
    messages: list
    max_tokens: int


LONG_OUTPUT_TAG = "长输出"

# 复测逐条输出的列：(表头, 显示宽度, 对齐)
PROBE_COLUMNS = (
    ("请求", 10, "<"),
    ("未命中输入", 10, ">"),
    ("读缓存", 8, ">"),
    ("输出", 6, ">"),
    ("Δ5h", 8, ">"),
    ("期望 Δ5h", 8, ">"),
    ("Δ7d", 8, ">"),
    ("TTFT", 7, ">"),
    ("TPS", 6, ">"),
)


def probe_steps(model_id: str, prefix_blocks: int, cache_hits: int) -> list:
    """单个模型的复测序列。

    1. 未缓存输入：prefix_blocks × 256 Token 的新前缀 → 测输入系数
    2. 缓存命中 × cache_hits：复用同一前缀 → 测读缓存系数
    3. 长输出：短输入 + 2048 Token 输出 → 测输出系数
    """
    uid = str(int(time.time() * 1000))[-8:]  # 每次复测都用新前缀，避免命中旧缓存
    n_words = prefix_blocks * CACHE_BLOCK - MODELS[model_id].prefix_overhead
    prefix = f"Session {uid}: " + " ".join(["apple"] * n_words)

    def short_question(i):
        return [
            {"role": "system", "content": prefix},
            {"role": "user", "content": f"Reply with the single word OK. [{i}]"},
        ]

    long_output = [
        {"role": "system", "content": f"Session {uid}x: Output benchmark."},
        {
            "role": "user",
            "content": "Write a continuous numbered list of short technical definitions "
            "in English from 1 to 2500, one per line.",
        },
    ]
    return [
        ProbeStep("未缓存输入", short_question(0), FIRST_REPLY_TOKENS),
        *(
            ProbeStep(f"缓存命中 {i}", short_question(i), CACHED_REPLY_TOKENS)
            for i in range(1, cache_hits + 1)
        ),
        ProbeStep(LONG_OUTPUT_TAG, long_output, LONG_OUTPUT_TOKENS),
    ]


def estimate_cost(model_id: str, prefix_blocks: int, cache_hits: int) -> float:
    """按当前系数估算一个模型的复测消耗（5h 比例）。"""
    prefix = prefix_blocks * CACHE_BLOCK
    tokens = Triple(
        inp=prefix + QUESTION_TOKENS * (cache_hits + 1) + LONG_PROMPT_TOKENS,
        cache=prefix * cache_hits,
        out=FIRST_REPLY_TOKENS + CACHED_REPLY_TOKENS * cache_hits + LONG_OUTPUT_TOKENS,
    )
    return quota_cost(MODELS[model_id].current, tokens)


def make_record(
    model_id: str, step: ProbeStep, result: ChatResult, before: Usage, after: Usage
) -> dict:
    """一次请求的日志记录（字段与 11-03 的旧日志兼容）。"""
    u = result.usage
    prompt = u.get("prompt_tokens", 0)
    cached = u.get("cached_tokens", 0) or (u.get("prompt_tokens_details") or {}).get(
        "cached_tokens", 0
    )
    return {
        "ts": time.time(),
        "model": model_id,
        "tag": step.tag,
        "max_tokens": step.max_tokens,
        "prompt_tokens": prompt,
        "in_miss": prompt - cached,
        "cached_tokens": cached,
        "completion_tokens": u.get("completion_tokens", 0),
        "reasoning_tokens": (u.get("completion_tokens_details") or {}).get(
            "reasoning_tokens", 0
        ),
        "ttft": result.ttft,
        "tps_decode": result.tps,
        "before_5h": before.used_5h,
        "after_5h": after.used_5h,
        "before_7d": before.used_7d,
        "after_7d": after.used_7d,
        "reset_5h": after.reset_5h,
    }


def probe_model(client: KimiClient, model_id: str, args, log_path: Path, before: Usage):
    """依次发送一个模型的复测请求，每次请求后读取额度并写日志；返回 (记录列表, 最后一次读数)。"""
    model = MODELS[model_id]
    headers, widths, align = zip(*PROBE_COLUMNS)
    print(f"\n>>> {model.name}（{model_id}）当前 5h 系数：{model.current}")
    print(format_row(headers, widths, align), flush=True)

    records = []
    for step in probe_steps(model_id, args.prefix_blocks, args.cache_hits):
        result = client.chat(model_id, step.messages, step.max_tokens)
        after = client.settled_usage()
        record = make_record(model_id, step, result, before, after)
        with open(log_path, "a", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + "\n")
        records.append(record)

        expected = quota_cost(model.current, billed_tokens(record))
        show_tps = step.tag == LONG_OUTPUT_TAG and result.tps
        cells = (
            step.tag,
            f"{record['in_miss']:,}",
            f"{record['cached_tokens']:,}",
            f"{record['completion_tokens']:,}",
            f"{after.used_5h - before.used_5h:+.4f}",
            f"{expected:.4f}",
            f"{after.used_7d - before.used_7d:+.4f}",
            f"{result.ttft:.2f}s",
            f"{result.tps}" if show_tps else "",
        )
        print(format_row(cells, widths, align), flush=True)
        if window_reset(before, after):
            print("  [警告] 5h 窗口在测试中重置，本次结果不可用", flush=True)
        before = after
    return records, before


def cmd_probe(args):
    estimates = {
        m: estimate_cost(m, args.prefix_blocks, args.cache_hits) for m in args.models
    }
    total = sum(estimates.values())
    client = KimiClient(load_key(args.api_key))
    before = client.settled_usage(wait=0.0)

    print_usage(before)
    print(
        "\n预计消耗 5h 额度："
        + "，".join(f"{MODELS[m].name} ≈{fmt_pct(e)}" for m, e in estimates.items())
        + f"；合计 ≈{fmt_pct(total)}"
    )
    if before.used_5h + total > MAX_5H_AFTER_PROBE:
        sys.exit("5h 剩余额度不足，已取消")
    if args.dry_run:
        print("（--dry-run：未发送任何对话请求）")
        return

    log_path = (
        Path(args.log)
        if args.log
        else DATA_DIR / time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") / time.strftime("probe_%H%M%S.jsonl")
    )
    log_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    print(f"日志：{rel_path(log_path)}")
    print("测试期间不要在其他地方使用这个账号", flush=True)

    records = []
    try:
        for model_id in args.models:
            model_records, before = probe_model(client, model_id, args, log_path, before)
            records += model_records
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        sys.exit(f"\n已中断：已完成的请求已写入 {rel_path(log_path)}，可用 analyze 分析")

    report(records, f"本次复测（{rel_path(log_path)}）")


# ============================================================ analyze：拟合系数


def contiguous_segments(records: list, window: str) -> list:
    """按相邻记录的读数是否首尾衔接，拆成若干连续段。"""
    segments = [[records[0]]]
    for r in records[1:]:
        if abs(r[f"before_{window}"] - segments[-1][-1][f"after_{window}"]) < 1e-9:
            segments[-1].append(r)
        else:
            segments.append([r])
    return segments


class RoundingLP:
    """在读数舍入误差约束下求参数的可行范围。

    额度读数保留 4 位小数，真实值 y* 与读数 y 满足 |y* - y| <= READING_ROUNDING。
    变量 = [每个 (窗口, 连续段) 的初始真实读数 x0] + [待求参数 θ]
    约束 = 每个检查点 |x0 + features(累计 Token, 窗口) · θ - y| <= READING_ROUNDING
    """

    def __init__(self, records: list, windows: tuple, features, n_params: int):
        groups = [(w, seg) for w in windows for seg in contiguous_segments(records, w)]
        self.n_x0 = len(groups)
        self.n = self.n_x0 + n_params
        self.A, self.b = [], []
        for g, (window, seg) in enumerate(groups):
            x0 = [0.0] * self.n_x0
            x0[g] = 1.0
            self._add(x0 + [0.0] * n_params, seg[0][f"before_{window}"])
            total = Triple(0.0, 0.0, 0.0)  # 累计 Token，单位 M
            for r in seg:
                total += billed_tokens(r).per_million()
                self._add(x0 + list(features(total, window)), r[f"after_{window}"])
        self.bounds = [(None, None)] * self.n_x0 + [(0.0, None)] * n_params

    def _add(self, row: list, y: float):
        self.A += [row, [-x for x in row]]
        self.b += [y + READING_ROUNDING, -y + READING_ROUNDING]

    @staticmethod
    def _solve(c, A, b, bounds):
        linprog = require("scipy.optimize", "scipy").linprog
        return linprog(c, A_ub=A, b_ub=b, bounds=bounds, method="highs")

    def interval(self, k: int):
        """第 k 个参数的严格可行区间 (lo, hi)；无解返回 None。"""
        idx = self.n_x0 + k
        c = [0.0] * self.n
        c[idx] = 1.0
        lo = self._solve(c, self.A, self.b, self.bounds)
        c[idx] = -1.0
        hi = self._solve(c, self.A, self.b, self.bounds)
        return (lo.x[idx], hi.x[idx]) if lo.success and hi.success else None

    def center(self):
        """最大安全裕度解：所有约束同时收紧 eps，取 eps 最大时的参数；无解返回 None。"""
        A = [row + [1.0] for row in self.A]  # |...| <= READING_ROUNDING - eps
        c = [0.0] * self.n + [-1.0]
        res = self._solve(c, A, self.b, self.bounds + [(0.0, READING_ROUNDING)])
        return res.x[self.n_x0 : self.n] if res.success else None


def scale_interval(records: list, rates: Triple):
    """假设实际系数 = s × rates，联立 5h 与 7d，返回 s 的可行区间。"""
    lp = RoundingLP(
        records,
        tuple(WINDOW_DIVISOR),
        lambda total, window: [rates.dot(total) / WINDOW_DIVISOR[window]],
        n_params=1,
    )
    return lp.interval(0)


def fit_window(records: list, window: str):
    """直接拟合某个窗口的三项系数：返回 (中心解, [三项各自的可行区间])。"""
    lp = RoundingLP(records, (window,), lambda total, _: total, n_params=3)
    return lp.center(), [lp.interval(k) for k in range(3)]


def verdict(model: Model, scale) -> str:
    """根据「实测 / 采用值」区间给出结论。"""
    if scale is None:
        return "无可行解：7d / 5h 比例可能变化，参考下面的分窗口拟合"
    lo, hi = scale
    if lo <= 1.0 <= hi:
        return "与采用值一致"
    for ratio, conclusion in model.known_states.items():
        if lo - STATE_TOLERANCE <= ratio <= hi + STATE_TOLERANCE:
            return f"{conclusion}（约 {ratio:g} 倍）"
    return f"可能已调整：实测 ≈ {(lo + hi) / 2:.3f} × 采用值"


def report_model(model: Model, records: list):
    tokens = sum((billed_tokens(r) for r in records), Triple(0, 0, 0))
    used_5h = sum(r["after_5h"] - r["before_5h"] for r in records)
    scale = scale_interval(records, model.current)
    scale_text = f"[{scale[0]:.4f}, {scale[1]:.4f}]" if scale else "—"

    print(f"\n[{model.name}] {len(records)} 次请求，5h 消耗 {fmt_pct(used_5h)}")
    print(f"  计费 Token：{' / '.join(f'{l} {t:,}' for l, t in zip(ITEMS, tokens))}")
    print(f"  采用值（5h）：{model.current}")
    print(f"  实测 / 采用值：{scale_text} → {verdict(model, scale)}")
    print("  分窗口拟合（中心解 [严格可行区间]）：")

    rows = []
    for window in WINDOW_DIVISOR:
        center, intervals = fit_window(records, window)
        if center is None:
            rows.append((window, "无可行解", "", ""))
            continue
        cells = []
        for c, iv, d in zip(center, intervals, FIT_DIGITS):
            cells.append(f"{c:.{d}f}" + (f" [{iv[0]:.{d}f}, {iv[1]:.{d}f}]" if iv else ""))
        rows.append((window, *cells))
    print_table(("窗口", *ITEMS), rows, indent="    ")


def report(records: list, title: str):
    print("\n" + "=" * 100)
    print(f"分析：{title}")
    print("=" * 100)
    if not records:
        print("（日志为空）")
    for model_id in dict.fromkeys(r["model"] for r in records):
        if model_id not in MODELS:
            print(f"\n[{model_id}] 不在 MODELS 中，跳过")
            continue
        report_model(MODELS[model_id], [r for r in records if r["model"] == model_id])


def resolve_logs(paths: list) -> list:
    """把命令行参数展开成日志文件列表：支持文件、目录与通配符；未指定时取 data/ 下最新一份。"""
    if not paths:
        logs = list(DATA_DIR.glob("**/*.jsonl"))
        if not logs:
            sys.exit(f"错误：{rel_path(DATA_DIR)} 下没有日志，请先运行 probe")
        latest = max(logs, key=lambda p: p.stat().st_mtime)
        print(f"未指定日志，分析最新一份：{rel_path(latest)}")
        return [latest]

    logs = []
    for arg in paths:
        path = Path(arg)
        if path.is_dir():
            found = sorted(path.glob("*.jsonl"))
        elif path.is_file():
            found = [path]
        else:  # cmd / PowerShell 不会展开通配符，这里自己展开
            found = sorted(Path(p) for p in glob.glob(arg))
        if not found:
            sys.exit(f"错误：找不到日志 {arg}")
        logs += found
    return logs


def load_records(path: Path) -> list:
    with open(path, encoding="utf-8") as f:
        return [json.loads(line) for line in f if line.strip()]


def cmd_analyze(args):
    for path in resolve_logs(args.logs):
        report(load_records(path), rel_path(path))


# ============================================================ 输出工具


def display_width(text: str) -> int:
    """终端显示宽度（中文等全角字符占 2 格）。"""
    return sum(2 if unicodedata.east_asian_width(ch) in "WF" else 1 for ch in text)


def pad(text: str, width: int, align: str = "<") -> str:
    """按显示宽度补空格；align 为 "<" 左对齐，">" 右对齐。"""
    gap = " " * max(0, width - display_width(text))
    return text + gap if align == "<" else gap + text


def format_row(cells, widths, align) -> str:
    return "  ".join(pad(str(c), w, a) for c, w, a in zip(cells, widths, align)).rstrip()


def print_table(header, rows, align: str = "", indent: str = ""):
    """打印按显示宽度对齐的表格；align 逐列给出 "<" 或 ">"，缺省左对齐。"""
    lines = [list(map(str, header))] + [list(map(str, row)) for row in rows]
    widths = [max(display_width(line[i]) for line in lines) for i in range(len(header))]
    align = align.ljust(len(header), "<")
    for line in lines:
        print(indent + format_row(line, widths, align))


def fmt_pct(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x * 100:.2f}%"


def fmt_price(x: float) -> str:
    return f"{x:.2f}" if x >= 0.1 else f"{x:.3g}"


def parse_time(iso):
    """解析接口返回的 ISO 时间（UTC），失败返回 None。"""
    try:
        t = datetime.fromisoformat(iso.replace("Z", "+00:00"))
    except (AttributeError, TypeError, ValueError):
        return None
    return t if t.tzinfo else t.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)


def fmt_reset(iso) -> str:
    """重置时间转成本地时间，并附上剩余时长。"""
    t = parse_time(iso)
    if t is None:
        return str(iso or "未知")
    local = t.astimezone().strftime("%m-%d %H:%M")
    left = int((t - datetime.now(timezone.utc)).total_seconds())
    if left <= 0:
        return local
    days, rest = divmod(left, 86400)
    hours, minutes = rest // 3600, rest % 3600 // 60
    if days:
        remain = f"{days} 天 {hours} 小时"
    elif hours:
        remain = f"{hours} 小时 {minutes} 分"
    else:
        remain = f"{minutes} 分"
    return f"{local}（{remain}后）"


def rel_path(path) -> str:
    """相对项目根目录的路径，便于阅读。"""
    path = Path(path).resolve()
    try:
        return path.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix()
    except ValueError:
        return str(path)


def require(module: str, package: str | None = None):
    """按需导入第三方依赖，缺失时提示安装命令。"""
    try:
        return importlib.import_module(module)
    except ImportError:
        package = package or module
        sys.exit(f"错误：缺少依赖 {package}，请先运行 pip install {package}")


# ============================================================ 命令行


def parse_models(text: str) -> list:
    if text.strip().lower() == "all":
        return list(MODELS)
    ids = list(dict.fromkeys(m.strip() for m in text.split(",") if m.strip()))
    unknown = [m for m in ids if m not in MODELS]
    if unknown or not ids:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            f"未知模型 {', '.join(unknown) or '（空）'}；可选：all, {', '.join(MODELS)}"
        )
    return ids


def parse_mix(text: str) -> list:
    try:
        values = [float(x) for x in text.split(",")]
    except ValueError:
        values = []
    if len(values) != 3 or min(values) < 0 or sum(values) <= 0:
        raise argparse.ArgumentTypeError(
            "应为 3 个非负数，依次是 Input,Output,CacheRead 的占比，例如 2.5,0.5,97"
        )
    return values


def build_parser() -> argparse.ArgumentParser:
    raw = argparse.RawDescriptionHelpFormatter
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(
        prog="kimi_quota.py", description=__doc__, formatter_class=raw
    )
    sub = parser.add_subparsers(dest="cmd", required=True, title="子命令")

    def add_key_option(p):
        p.add_argument(
            "--api-key",
            default="",
            help="API Key（不指定时读取环境变量 KIMI_API_KEY 或 .kimi_key）",
        )

    p = sub.add_parser("status", help="查看当前 5h / 7d 额度用量与重置时间")
    add_key_option(p)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_status)

    p = sub.add_parser("budget", help="按采用值估算各模型可用 Token 与订阅折算价（不调用接口）")
    p.add_argument(
        "--mix",
        type=parse_mix,
        default=DEFAULT_MIX,
        metavar="IN,OUT,CACHE",
        help="Input,Output,CacheRead 的用量占比，按此顺序逗号分隔，"
        "不必凑满 100（默认 %(default)s）",
    )
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_budget)

    model_list = "\n".join(
        f"  {pad(model_id, 28)}{m.name}（{m.source}）" for model_id, m in MODELS.items()
    )
    p = sub.add_parser(
        "probe",
        help="调用接口复测扣费系数，结束后自动分析",
        description="调用接口复测扣费系数。默认约消耗 2.3% 的 5h 额度、耗时 2–3 分钟，"
        "测试期间不要在其他地方使用这个账号。",
        epilog=f"可选模型：\n{model_list}",
        formatter_class=raw,
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--models",
        type=parse_models,
        default=DEFAULT_PROBE_MODELS,
        help="逗号分隔的模型 ID，或 all 表示全部（默认 %(default)s）",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--cache-hits",
        type=int,
        default=2,
        metavar="N",
        help="缓存命中请求次数；要测准读缓存系数可加到 12 左右（默认 %(default)s）",
    )
    p.add_argument(
        "--prefix-blocks",
        type=int,
        default=160,
        metavar="N",
        help="缓存前缀长度，单位 256 Token（默认 %(default)s ≈ 41K）",
    )
    p.add_argument("--dry-run", action="store_true", help="只显示当前用量与预计消耗，不发对话请求")
    p.add_argument("--log", metavar="PATH", help="日志路径（默认 data/<日期>/probe_<时间>.jsonl）")
    add_key_option(p)
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_probe)

    p = sub.add_parser("analyze", help="分析复测日志（不指定时分析最新一份）")
    p.add_argument(
        "logs", nargs="*", metavar="LOG", help="日志文件、目录或通配符，可指定多个"
    )
    p.set_defaults(func=cmd_analyze)
    return parser


def main():
    for stream in (sys.stdout, sys.stderr):
        if isinstance(stream, io.TextIOWrapper):
            stream.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8")  # Windows 终端 / 管道下输出中文
    args = build_parser().parse_args()
    try:
        args.func(args)
    except ApiError as e:
        sys.exit(f"错误：{e}")
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        sys.exit("\n已中断")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

换算方法
按照 月额度 = 5 × 周额度，周额度 = 5 × 5h 额度，把周额度的 1% 记作 1 点，那么 5h 额度就是 20 点
用 20 点除以 5H 用量（M Token），就能得到每 1M token 扣多少点：

【我在L站搞科研】浅析 Kimi 会员计划模型计费制度：以 Allegro 套餐 Code 额度为例 搞七捻三
订阅老版 Kimi 会员计划的 Allegro（699 元/月）套餐已有数月，日常高强度用下来一直对套餐内部的实际扣费规则比较好奇，恰逢近期 K3.1 系列上线，索性做了一轮定量实测，把 Code 额度下 6 个模型的计费方程、之前大家讨论好久的 K3 256K 阈值规则、折算官方 API 的回本价值以及各模型吞吐算了一遍，分享给佬友们一同探讨。需要说明的是，该套餐实际还包含月度总额度，但受限于无…

参考上面这位佬友的方法进行了校准，结果如下：

Allegretto（¥199），K3.1 Pro

计费项 5h 权重 (M⁻¹) 7d 权重 (M⁻¹) 相对 Allegro
输入 0.2810 [0.2808, 0.2811] 0.0562 3.00×
读缓 0.001407 [0.001372, 0.001425] 0.000281 2.98×
输出 2.247 [2.243, 2.261] 0.449 2.99×

权重 = 每 1M token 消耗该窗口额度的比例（×100 即百分比）

例如 5h 输入权重 0.2810 表示：每输出 1M token 消耗 28.1% 的 5h 额度

方括号内为严格可行区间。

  • 比例 1 : 1/200 : 8.0，与 Allegro 完全一致，Allegro ≈ Allegretto * 3
  • 7d = 5 × 5h，月 = 5 × 7d
  • 控制台明细单位是月额度百分比，按 max(0.01, 四舍五入) 显示，所以小请求会被高估
